features.name: Frontend UI
features.plain_english: The web dashboard where users upload documents, view charts, explore the supply chain graph, and chat with the AI.

features.name: API Client
features.plain_english: The frontend's connection layer that sends requests to the backend server.

features.name: FastAPI Server
features.plain_english: The main backend server that handles all API requests from the frontend.

features.name: PDF Analysis Engine
features.plain_english: Extracts text from PDFs and Excel files, then uses AI to identify materials, energy use, and transport emissions.

features.name: Analytics & Charts
features.plain_english: Generates interactive charts — carbon hotspot bars, emission breakdown pie, and supply chain Sankey diagram.

features.name: PDF Report Generator
features.plain_english: Creates professional ISO 14067 carbon footprint reports as downloadable PDFs.

features.name: Search & Emission Factors
features.plain_english: Looks up verified emission factors from a trusted database or searches the web for unknown materials.

features.name: Graph RAG Chat
features.plain_english: An AI consultant that answers questions by reading the Neo4j graph database.

features.name: Audit Memory Store
features.plain_english: Remembers past audits so the system can suggest similar ones based on materials used.

features.name: Neo4j Database Layer
features.plain_english: Stores the supply chain as a graph of projects, materials, energy, and transport nodes connected by relationships.

features.name: Configuration
features.plain_english: Loads environment variables and settings for all backend services.

external_services.name: OpenRouter AI
external_services.purpose: Runs Owl-Alpha model to analyze supply chain documents and answer chat questions.

external_services.name: Serper.dev
external_services.purpose: Google Search API that finds real emission factor data and source URLs for unknown materials.

external_services.name: Neo4j Cloud (Aura)
external_services.purpose: Cloud-hosted Neo4j graph database that stores the supply chain data.
